answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one tide weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The lagoon report shows the merge explicitly at each hollow. Because of that, someone who spins up 229 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 23 times the capital for one share. A farm of 3180 identities would post 850 proofs and burn roughly 5 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
